title: A hypothetical request deadline budget
method: Planning envelope totals 900 ms: local work 100 + 2 attempts × 300 + one delay 100 + reserve 100. Actual pool waits, cancellation and scheduling must fit; this is not a latency measurement.
alt: A hypothetical request deadline budget. Local work: 100 milliseconds; Two downstream attempts: 600 milliseconds; Retry delay: 100 milliseconds; Reserve: 100 milliseconds. Illustrative inputs.
